text:
Ivy: Heads up - noticed surge in healthscore changes from enablement events, looks like duplicates from old CRM backfill.
Diego: Example: acct_LKJ had enablement_completed x2 within 30s, second payload missing event_guid.
Renee: Can we collapse duplicates and pause automation briefly? Prefer targeted dedupe rather than global pause.
ops-bot: ALERT: webhook-backfill-queue length=87k retries=9.
Diego: Plan: compute fingerprint = sha1(account_id + '|' + event_type + '|' + to_min(event_ts)), collapse duplicates keeping earliest. Will dry-run on 50k sample.
Ivy: Also add temporary rule in playbook-runner: if fingerprint seen within 1h skip. Low-risk change.
Renee: I'll prepare AE suppression list for top 100 affected accounts and export CSV to shared drive.
eng-oncall: I'll review dedupe tool and can run in prod during low-traffic window.
Diego: Dry-run results: scanned=50k duplicates=960 collapsed=954. Looks safe.
Ivy: Approve live dedupe + runner guard. Please log all rollbacks with reason=dedupe-correction.
ops-bot: ACTION: ticket CSOPS-5342 created "enablement event duplicates -> inflated healthscore" Assigned: Ivy, Diego, Renee.
Renee: Starting live dedupe in 15m, will post completion summary.
Diego: Merged runner-guard PR to canary 10%. Monitoring duplicate rate metric.
Ivy: Thanks team. Postmortem + runbook updates next steps: require event_guid or stable id on any ingestion, and backfills must include idempotency_key.
Renee: Dedupe done: scanned=1,130,222 duplicates=24,102 collapsed=24,080. Health corrections queued=3,210. Will process at 500/min.
Diego: Metric duplicate_rate dropped to 0.02% after corrections.
Ivy: Great work. Will schedule quick retro tomorrow 09:30 UTC.
